title: Most people think the narrow gate is difficult because God made salvation hard.
paragraphs: Most people think the narrow gate is difficult because God made salvation hard.
But that isn’t what Jesus Christ meant.
The narrow gate is difficult because of what it requires us to leave behind.
The wide road asks for almost nothing.

You can carry your pride.
You can carry your secret sin.
You can carry your need for control.
You can carry your love for the approval of people.
Nothing has to change.
That is why it is crowded.
But the narrow gate is different.
You cannot walk through it while holding everything you love.
Pride must be released.
Bitterness must be released.
The illusion that you are in control must be released.
This is why the narrow gate feels costly.
But here is the deeper truth.

The wide road feels easy at first…
but it becomes heavy over time.

The narrow gate feels costly at first…
but it leads to freedom.
What feels restrictive in the beginning becomes life in the end.
That is why Jesus Christ said only a few find it.
Not because it is hidden.
But because surrender is hard.
What do you think is the hardest thing for people to leave behind when entering the narrow gate?
